patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Hunter and LinkedIn Sales Navigator share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Hunter and LinkedIn Sales Navigator share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Hunter only if your buying job matches “Domain email finder, verifier, and cold email sequences (All-in-one) — Free 50 credits; St” rather than LinkedIn Sales Navigator's shape. Choose LinkedIn Sales Navigator only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn’s AI-powered B2B sales tool for network prospecting, Buyer Intent, and InMail — C” rather than Hunter's shape. Workflow advantage: Hunter leans email-outreach, data-enrichment; LinkedIn Sales Navigator leans lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Hunter and LinkedIn Sales Navigator share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Hunter is Domain email finder, verifier, and cold email sequences (All-in-one) — Free 50 credits; Starter from $49/mo.; LinkedIn Sales Navigator is LinkedIn’s AI-powered B2B sales tool for network prospecting, Buyer Intent, and InMail — Core from US$119.99/mo; Advanced Plus for CRM sync..
- Workflow coverage skew: Hunter-leaning email-outreach, data-enrichment vs LinkedIn Sales Navigator-leaning lead-management.
- Researched limits: Hunter — Contact data is email/domain-centric — weaker as a full phone+firmographic mega-database; LinkedIn Sales Navigator — Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info.

Limitations — Hunter: Contact data is email/domain-centric — weaker as a full phone+firmographic mega-database; Lead scoring is limited versus enterprise SI platforms; LinkedIn Sales Navigator: Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info; No bulk InMail; messages are individual with monthly InMail credits (50/mo stated on plans).

Poor-fit cases: Hunter is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Contact data is email/domain-centric — weaker as a full phone+firmographic mega-database · LinkedIn Sales Navigator is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info · Avoid Hunter if you actually need LinkedIn Sales Navigator's motion (LinkedIn’s AI-powered B2B sales tool for network prospecting, Buyer Intent, and )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
